title: KYE Directory Entry (v1)
description: Public directory record for a KYE-registered entity. The minimum projection that lets a counterparty discover, classify, and verify another entity without leaking sensitive metadata. Indexed by Discovery; gated by Discoverability policy.

class.description: Entity class label (e.g. 'agent', 'org', 'tool', 'model', 'role'). §0.30 graft (2026-06-08): 'agent' is a first-class canonical class with full principal identity, §52 authority binding, and §23 metering wiring — not a sub-variant of any other class.

trust_domain.description: KYEID of the trust domain that registered this entity.

certification_tier.description: Certification tier currently held by the entity. Determines downstream policy treatment.

jurisdiction.description: ISO-3166 jurisdictions the entity is legally seated/registered in.

public.description: Whether the entry is publicly discoverable. False entries are only resolvable via authorised discovery.

indexed_at.description: Time the directory last (re)indexed this entry.

display_name.description: Optional human-friendly display name shown in directory UIs.

endpoints.description: Optional list of public endpoints (e.g. metadata, well-known) for the entity.
